how: Calls seek additional growers for a work already present rather than documenting its original founding.
A call for all hands explicitly addresses a flag being built over the tree.
A participant judges existing arrangements inadequate for survival and prescribes a plan and maintenance script.
A question asks what a red horizontal line cutting through the tree represents without preserving its answer.
A difficult-night account does not establish quitting or repair of a quarrel between members.
Growth proposals, successive mock-ups, and competing outline preferences keep the work open to redesign.
An explicit vote request supports attempted decided order, whereas a generic expansion proposal cannot establish a vote or its outcome.
A progress announcement reports shared work without independently establishing the placed image.
A comment brings the claimed existence and reach of a chat-known agreement back to the public discussion.
A maintenance script is prescribed rather than reported as implemented.
The perceived need for scripting under strain is stated, but subsequent machine placement is not established.
Mock-up titles establish offered guidance without showing pixel-level specifications or an adopted template.
Mock-up titles and a later vote request do not establish template-based settlement of design.
A bare declaration of joining supports the minimal acceptance form without identifying a call being answered.
A bare-join submission does not preserve an identified call-and-answer pair or establish its conversational mechanism.
The earliest retained proposal concerns expansion of existing work and leaves its original starter unidentified.
Expansion of existing work and calls for growers do not establish a starter causing recruitment.
Recruitment calls and later progress reports do not establish that those calls caused building.
Reported chat dealings do not establish secrecy, hidden plans, or infiltration of rivals.
A colour rule against void footholds does not establish site faults or workarounds.
Defense calls and colour rules support repair practice, while the added mechanism of uninformed keepers erasing agreed changes remains untested.
A warning attributes damage to suspected bots while preserving uncertainty about their connection to the void.
Early defense calls and a later progress report do not establish one initial transition from building to upkeep.
Agreements, boundary permission, and negotiations during overwriting establish dealings with neighbors without establishing universal compliance.
Participants urge sparing neighboring works and receive an apology from someone speaking for another group.
A rebuilding offer supports offered inter-room help without demonstrating how much repair was delivered.
The revised entry directly covers stated limits on a deal reaching inattentive placers without requiring an authority dispute.
A request for a contact fits seeking someone to deal with without establishing a mandate to bind every placer.
An agreement already described as known in chat is discussed through a stated compliance limit, supporting the bounded agreement-to-limit reading.
Inferring restraint from a deal requires reaching willing placers because helpful contacts and uncontrolled expansion can coexist.
Encroachment, defense, and negotiation are connected in one passage, but whether defense initiated the talks remains unresolved.
An agreement and a later rebuilding offer do not establish that border talk caused help to be traded.
Perceived insufficiency and an offer of help do not establish the full causal sequence of seeking and receiving help under strain.
Boundary permission and help offers do not establish a coalition or its commitments.
Defense and negotiation do not establish an attack causing coalition formation.
A contact request and an announced deal do not identify a coded envoy carrying a proposal between venues.
Moderator-granted boundary permission supports limited conditional access without establishing host rule over the whole work.
An early proposal to expand right establishes a proposed direction before the named loss without proving subsequent placement.
An explicit response to destruction is building up an existing sapling as the new tree.
Explicitly named destruction prompts renewed building from an existing sapling, retaining a local return to design and growth beyond the standing arrows.
Rebuilding explicitly answers destruction without establishing a prior manpower judgment as its cause.
A removal proposal and an apology do not preserve an argument about whether covering art is fair.
A declaration of joining does not establish simultaneous membership, divided loyalty, or reassurance across two rooms.
Tree imagery and resilience language do not establish an inherited collective ideology or colour faith.
The removal proposal cites a duplicate larger flag without establishing an inherited quarrel.
A locally justified removal proposal does not identify a prior tie as its reason.
Remembering apples does not independently establish a newly adopted canvas joke.
Outreach to growers does not establish the founding of a room or the formation of a negotiating faction.
Protecting a symbol does not establish an exchange policing offensive speech or hate symbols.
Expansion talk does not establish a separate host-sub April Fools prank frame.
Wanting growers to find the room does not establish its creation, moderation boundaries, or hosting rules.
Calls and a findability problem do not establish a canvas-post flood causing a moderation boundary.
Canvas proposals and recruitment concerns do not establish posting objections causing attacks on the room's own work.
Attempting to make the organizing room findable through signage precedes any demonstrated arrival through the work.
Proposed signage and a stated findability problem do not establish actual arrivals, subscriber gains, or reception into ordinary activity.
Addressing potential growers does not establish addressing creators, staff, companies, or press outside the canvas.
Progress praise and survival celebrations mark shared achievement while allowing the intended tree to remain unfinished.
A long arduous night supports a retrospective account of burden without establishing individual schedules or device constraints.
An apparent loss, imagined completed art, and remembrance preserve different accounts of the work's fate.
Celebration-led remembrance is one route to recording, since threatened-loss mourning already occurs before the later survival announcement.
A progress report and a survival celebration do not independently establish a completed-work-to-celebration mechanism.
Imagining a finished tree does not establish contesting a shared cleanup or correcting another account of the work.
Remembering the work leaves any decision about a lasting collective purpose unobserved.
Remembrance does not establish a transition to continuing activity or ties.
Proposed removal of another flag for expansion is proposed encroachment, with implementation unobserved.
Recruitment and a displacement proposal do not show a call turning particular respondents toward attack.
Later restraint does not establish an answering refusal of the specific flag-removal proposal.
A later announced agreement does not establish the removal proposal causing negotiation.
A friendly retrospective title supports a minimal salute without independently identifying a rival or establishing extended contest in talk.
The removal proposal and retrospective greeting do not establish a particular attack call producing later contest in talk.
